moments.author: Yogesh Ghaturle
moments.quote: Thrilled to announce that @origin_autonomy has raised $20M in total funding, co‑led by @Accel and @ZacuaVentures. We're building general‑purpose robots for interior construction.
moments.why: It’s blowing up because the post revealed a $20M funding round and futuristic ‘general‑purpose’ construction robots—especially compelling for men 25–45 with interest in tech, robotics, and infrastructure.

moments.author: Anthropic (official announcement)
moments.quote: Anthropic has moved Code Review … out of research preview for Claude Team and Enterprise, with up to $50,000 in free credits for eligible enterprises.
moments.why: Going GA with multi‑agent automated code review and free credits is trending hard among devs and techies, especially those 25–45 following AI tooling.

moments.author: Kevin Byard (via Patriots)
moments.quote: That’s MVP Drake right there. That’s a dot. Aw man, that’s so pretty. It’s like poetry in motion.
moments.why: This mic‑d up praise for quarterback Drake Maye in a clip went viral—highlighting big‑play QB hype that sports‑fans 25–45 are loving.

moments.author: Yogesh Ghaturle / mentions of OG‑1 speed claim
moments.quote: Origin's OG‑1 robot finishes drywall about three times faster than a human crew.
moments.why: The claim of a robot outperforming human crews 3× over quickly sparked debate and interest among audiences into deep‑tech and automation.
